rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent stepped bar across all four views, so it is not rejected for single-view coherence or obvious view-to-view collision. The dominant gesture is legible and the parcel is respected, but the mass still leans toward a compact extruded bar with limited spatial generosity at ground level. The west-facing access relation is present, yet the public response is mostly a notch rather than a more forceful court/undercut, so void publicness is only moderate. Programmatically, the form can plausibly support neighborhood living because the section is calm, low-rise, and capacity-aware, but it needs a slightly stronger public threshold and more explicit ground void to fully align with the active-edge brief. Overall it is a solid early-stage massing with acceptable hierarchy and good repair integrity, but not yet a standout spatial figure.
